def minPath(grid, k)
  n = grid.length
  best = nil

  (0...n).each do |r|
    (0...n).each do |c|
      path = [grid[r][c]]
      (k - 1).times do
        best_val = Float::INFINITY
        best_pos = nil
        [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]].each do |dr, dc|
          nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
          if nr.between?(0, n - 1) && nc.between?(0, n - 1)
            val = grid[nr][nc]
            if val < best_val
              best_val = val
              best_pos = [nr, nc]
            end
          end
        end
        r, c = best_pos
        path << grid[r][c]
      end
      if best.nil? || path < best
        best = path
      end
    end
  end
  best
end

  a, b = 0, 1
  count = 0
  loop do
